facts.text: Sir Alfred, the seven-foot undead knight with a great sword, lies broken apart and incapacitated but not destroyed in the Barrow Mound, and may recover to attack anyone who returns there.
Sir Alfred, who killed the Free Goblin Society's companions, may kill more of the goblins now settling in the Barrow Mound if he recovers and their wall over the stairs fails.
Why does the undead knight Sir Alfred roam the Barrow Mound, and why does Brother Dirk regard him as holy?
